# Brand Vitals: page summaries

Last updated: 2026-10-16
One summary per page, written to be quoted. Every page also exists in Arabic under https://brandvitals.io/ar/

## Brand Vitals
https://brandvitals.io/
Brand Vitals: Growth partner for Egypt & Saudi. A marketing agency in New Cairo, Cairo, Egypt, for brands in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: brand strategy, creative production, websites and performance marketing in one system, measured on revenue, orders and qualified leads. Engagements are scoped by written proposal after a free growth audit.

## Services
### Performance Marketing Agency in Egypt & MENA
https://brandvitals.io/performance-marketing.html
Brand Vitals runs performance marketing on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat for brands in Egypt and Saudi Arabia, measured on revenue, qualified leads and cost per acquisition. It suits businesses that already sell and want paid social to pay back. Work starts with a free audit of your accounts, tracking and margins.

### Google Ads Management Agency in Cairo, Egypt
https://brandvitals.io/google-ads.html
Brand Vitals manages Google Ads in Arabic and English for businesses in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: search, Performance Max, YouTube and call tracking, built around conversions you can verify. It suits brands whose customers search before they buy. Work starts with a free audit of your account and tracking.

### SEO Agency in Egypt
https://brandvitals.io/seo.html
Brand Vitals is an Arabic SEO agency in Egypt that ranks bilingual websites in the language customers search in: technical fixes, Arabic keyword research, content and local SEO, plus readiness for AI search. It suits brands with a site worth growing. Work starts with a free technical audit.

### Branding Agency in Cairo
https://brandvitals.io/branding.html
Brand Vitals is a branding agency in Cairo that builds brand strategy, naming, visual identity and guidelines in Arabic and English, then turns them into campaigns with Vitals Frames. It suits new brands and brands that have outgrown their look. Work starts with a free consultation.

### Website Design & CRO in Egypt
https://brandvitals.io/web-cro.html
Brand Vitals designs bilingual websites and landing pages in Egypt and runs conversion rate optimization (CRO), so more visitors become customers from the same traffic. It suits brands paying for traffic that does not convert. Fixed-price sites are built by Vitals Web; work starts with a free audit.

### GA4 & Server-Side Tracking in Egypt
https://brandvitals.io/analytics-tracking.html
Brand Vitals sets up analytics and tracking for brands in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: GA4, Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking, conversion tracking and dashboards, so marketing decisions run on numbers you can trust. It suits any business spending on ads. Work starts with a free tracking audit.

## Industries
### E-commerce Marketing Agency in Egypt & GCC
https://brandvitals.io/ecommerce-marketing.html
Brand Vitals grows online stores in Egypt and Saudi Arabia with paid media, creative, CRO and retention, measured on contribution margin rather than ROAS alone. It suits e-commerce brands on Shopify, WooCommerce, Salla, Zid or custom platforms. Work starts with a free growth audit of your store, ads and tracking.

### Real Estate Marketing in Egypt & Saudi Arabia
https://brandvitals.io/real-estate-marketing.html
Brand Vitals markets real estate projects in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: positioning, project films with Vitals Frames, paid campaigns and lead forms that qualify buyers before sales calls them. It suits developers and brokers who need leads their sales team wants to call. Work starts with a free consultation.

### Healthcare & Clinic Marketing in Egypt & the GCC
https://brandvitals.io/healthcare-marketing.html
Brand Vitals markets clinics, hospitals and healthcare groups in Egypt and the GCC, measured on bookings rather than inquiries. Campaigns, tracking and creative follow platform health policies and connect every lead to the booking system. It suits providers with several services or branches. Work starts with a free consultation.

## Ecosystem
### Vitals Frames: Content made to perform
https://brandvitals.io/frames.html
Vitals Frames is the Brand Vitals production studio in Cairo for brands, in-house teams and agencies: social and ad design, reels and short-form video, UGC, production shoots, retouching, shooters on demand and podcast production. Monthly plans start from EGP 30,000 (Starter), EGP 60,000 (Growth) and EGP 110,000 (Scale); work is also taken per project.

### Vitals Web: Websites live in weeks
https://brandvitals.io/web.html
Vitals Web is the Brand Vitals website studio: Arabic and English websites on three fixed packages and timelines. Launch (one landing page, 2 weeks, from EGP 25,000), Business (company site, 4 weeks, from EGP 60,000) and Commerce (online store on Salla, Zid or Shopify, 6 weeks, from EGP 90,000).

### Vitals Stage: Events produced end to end
https://brandvitals.io/stage.html
Vitals Stage plans, manages and produces business events from Cairo: conferences, corporate events, product launches, exhibitions, brand activations and workshops, with one accountable team from the first brief to the final report. Opening in phases; now taking event production and coverage (photo, video, live social).

### Vitals GO: Client approvals & paid extras
https://brandvitals.io/go.html
Vitals GO is client approval software for agencies, in beta with founding agencies: send work on one link, the client approves on WhatsApp, email or SMS without an account, and anything outside scope is priced, approved and invoiced. One price per agency by active clients: EGP 1,500 a month (1 to 5), EGP 4,500 (6 to 15), EGP 9,500 (16 to 40); team and clients are free.

### Vitals Crew: Vetted creative talent
https://brandvitals.io/crew.html
Vitals Crew is a marketplace of vetted creative talent run by Brand Vitals. Freelancers pass a portfolio review, a paid test and an interview, and every delivery passes QA. Jobs are reviewed within 24 hours, clients get the three best proposals with reasons, pay the agreed price plus a 20% service fee, and payment is held until approval.

### Vitals Hire: Marketing hiring, screened
https://brandvitals.io/hire.html
Vitals Hire is a hiring platform for marketing and creative roles, launching first in Saudi Arabia and Saudization-ready. Candidates build one profile and apply in a step; Brand Vitals reads every application and companies receive only the people who fit, with a note on why. Every application gets an answer within 48 hours.

## Free tools
### Vitals Score
https://brandvitals.io/vitals-score.html
Vitals Score is a free website and marketing health check. It scans a site with Google's Lighthouse engine, checks Arabic and SEO readiness, asks four questions about marketing, and returns a score out of 100 with the three fixes that matter most.

### Vitals Forecast
https://brandvitals.io/forecast.html
Vitals Forecast is a free planner for ad budgets in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Enter a budget, average order or deal value and gross margin to see break-even ROAS (one divided by gross margin), a three-month Conservative / Expected / Strong range and what has to be true to hit a target. Every result is a range: a forecast, not a guarantee.

## Reference
### Egypt vs Saudi Arabia marketing guide
https://brandvitals.io/egypt-vs-saudi-marketing.html
Marketing in Egypt and Saudi Arabia needs two plans, not one plan in two languages. Egyptians often ask on WhatsApp and pay cash on delivery; Saudis expect local dialect, Mada or Apple Pay and VAT-inclusive prices, and buy around a few seasonal moments. Both markets work Sunday to Thursday.

### Marketing glossary
https://brandvitals.io/glossary.html
Plain definitions of the marketing terms used on the Brand Vitals site, grouped into measurement, tracking, paid media, websites and search, brand, and Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
